name: Monkephobia Reincarnated
summary:
Immerse Yourself.

You’ve just accepted an offer on a mysterious vintage game. The game is old, decrepit forgotten. But the moment you press start, everything changes. The world around you goes black and you awake inside the game.
What was once a curiosity is now a pixelated nightmare, rendered in eerie PS1-style visuals. The only way forward is through using hand-driven locomotion inspired by Gorilla Tag, you’ll crawl, climb, and scramble your way through a shifting digital hell.
